cases.name: Refused

notes: Nothing from Refused was imported, because Solara couldn't save its workspace.

cases.difference: Script records done with zero tabs when the native workspace command refuses; Swift fails the three requested kinds and explains the refusal.

cases.name: Theme-rejection

notes: The imported theme could not be adopted; the existing theme was kept.

cases.difference: The acknowledgement is a Swift-only operation. Its handler persists adoption metadata before the injected rejection; Swift keeps the old theme and imports two tabs. Script imports the valid source theme and finishes done.

cases.name: Unavailable-prompt

notes: Nothing from Clash was imported, because Solara couldn't set up a profile for it.

cases.difference: Native nil prompt is an unavailable destination. The legacy shell abort is confirmed=false and merges into the existing Clash profile without opening a modal alert.

cases.name: Cancel-after-adoption

notes: Import was cancelled. Anything saved before that is kept.

cases.difference: Only bridge acknowledgements are paused after their handlers: Swift favicon adoption, or the script route confirm-abort acknowledgement for the second-space clash. Script has committed the first two tabs; Swift has committed no tabs. Cancel/dispose aborts the script run signal and stops the Swift control before either can write the later destination.

cases.name: Create-refusal

notes: Nothing from New was imported, because Solara couldn't set up a profile for it.

cases.difference: Swift reports an unavailable new destination; script surfaces the native createProfile error and attributes the source profile even with a single selected source.
